callouts.text:
MACD CROSSED DOWN
4 sessions of falling histogram

points: Down 30% from 82,814 (6 May) to 57,718 (1 Jul), then five weeks of chop. At 63,506 price sits mid-range, in the most heavily traded band of the whole window.
The ceiling has rejected three times — 65,560 (15 Jul), 66,924 (21 Jul), 65,426 (9 Aug). The floor has held twice — 62,160 (18 Jun), 62,210 (1 Aug).
MACD has crossed below its signal and the histogram has fallen four sessions running (+89 → −93): the first sustained downside momentum since early July.
67,000–75,000 is almost untraded — the May collapse left no structure there — so a daily close above 67,000 could travel quickly toward 76,000.
summary.bias: Trend bias: NEUTRAL — range 62,000 to 66,900, edge is at the edges
summary.invalidation: below 62,000 opens 59,000–60,000; above 67,000 opens the air pocket toward 76,000
